capability.name: AIF Connection Points
capability.description: Validates AIF connection point prims for thermal, electrical, and airflow interfaces.

requirements.name: connectionpoints-scope-structure
requirements.message: Connection point prims must be organized under a ConnectionPoints Scope prim.

requirements.name: connection-point-geometry-type
requirements.message: Connection point prims must be Plane or Disk geometry only.

requirements.name: connection-point-purpose-guide
requirements.message: All connection point prims must have purpose = 'guide'.

requirements.name: connection-point-naming-convention
requirements.message: Connection point prims must follow the <vendor>_<type>_<suffix> naming pattern with a valid type prefix.

requirements.name: connection-points-composition
requirements.message: Connection points must be saved as <AssetName>_ConnectionPoints.usd and composed as a sublayer.

requirements.name: connection-point-alignment
requirements.message: Connection point geometry must be positioned and sized to match actual openings on equipment.
